title: sepsis-ards-shared-hub-genes: code, derived results, and data inventory for the sepsis/ARDS shared hub-gene study
description: Analysis code, derived results, and the complete input inventory for the shared hub-gene and immune-signature study of sepsis and ARDS (Supplementary Methods S1-S14). Contains the R, Python and shell scripts for all fourteen analysis stages driven by run_all.sh (twelve stages), the figure scripts for main Figures 1-10 and Supplementary Figures S1-S27 in four formats, 421 frozen result tables across 13 modules from which every figure can be redrawn, the manuscript text and Supplementary Methods, and all 28 supplementary tables. Also includes DATA_INVENTORY.md/csv (accessions, platforms, versions and access dates for every public input), FETCH_PUBLIC_DATA.md (retrieval runbook), RESULTS_TO_CODE.md (module-level result-to-code index), PATHS.md (path conventions) and environment/tool_versions.txt. Raw public data are not redistributed: all inputs are third-party resources re-downloadable from GEO, IEU OpenGWAS, FinnGen, eQTLGen, Human Protein Atlas, PDB, ChEMBL and Open Targets.
notes: Secondary analysis of public data. Corresponding author: Dansen Wu (wds_9201851126@fjmu.edu.cn), Fuzhou University Affiliated Provincial Hospital, Fuzhou, China.
